description: Code quality lint rules for Go — enforces logging over printing, error wrapping, and init avoidance

logging.description: Enforce structured logging over print statements

rules.description: No fmt.Println in production Go — use a structured logger
rules.message: Replace fmt.Println with your project's structured logger (slog, zap, logrus)

rules.description: Wrap errors with context using fmt.Errorf %w
rules.message: Use fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err) to wrap errors with context instead of concatenation
init() runs implicitly and is hard to test — prefer explicit initialization functions
